name: Townhouse OAK Makati Manila Near PNR Pasay Evangelista formerly VIP Suites
detail: The cost performance is the best! The front staff were very kind. There were no amenities, but that wasn't a problem. There was a built-in hairdryer. They gave me towels when I asked. I had the four-person room all to myself. Personally, I had no issues at all. I would love to come back.

name: Savea Bay City Manila
detail: I am almost perfectly satisfied with the size of the room, cleanliness, amenities, and location. However, there is one point: the shower temperature is low every time, so I believe it would be even more comfortable if you could improve it to allow for a higher temperature.

name: Townhouse College Residences in University Belt, Metro Manila
detail: yung room naka dorm style for 2 and maganda naman yung loc kasi malapit sa schools. problem ko lang is may mga times na nawawalan ng kuryente and bumabalik mga 1hr max, sa 4d3n namin na pagstay mga 3x ko rin na experience yun and had to ask the reception kung bat walang kuryente. also, walang mga essentials so kailangan talaga bumili before or after check-in. for staffs, okay naman sila and mababait naman. still recommended!

name: New World Makati Hotel
detail: This is my usual hotel during my stay in Manila. It really does not fall short of a five-star hotel, with strict security, smiling staff, attentiveness, friendly approachability, cleanliness from daily room cleaning, and quick responses to any shortages when called. There is truly a stable sense of security and satisfaction every time I stay, and the location has Greenbelt, Glorietta, SM, Landmark, and many restaurants from various countries just across the street, allowing for dining without facing traffic. Plus, everything from daily goods to high-end brand shops are available, so I can find almost everything I want or want to eat in this one area, allowing me to relax in the hotel and be free of stress and enjoy a comfortable stay. For me, New World Makati is an indispensable location, and I don't have to worry about safety, making Manila a one-choice destination for me. As for improvements, I think some areas need renovation since they are showing signs of aging. Also, while the buffet breakfast is very good, the menu is always the same, so I would like to see it change a bit each month. It’s delicious, but having the same menu all the time can get boring… Even considering that, when I think about the location, safety, and hotel service during my stay in Manila, New World Makati Hotel is the best.

name: Go Hotels Ermita
detail: Adjacent to Robinsons supermarket, there are many restaurants, nightclubs, and casinos nearby, and it is very close to Rizal Park. You can get up early to see the locals exercising in the morning. I've never experienced the criticized poor security in Manila. The service and assistance from the staff exceeded expectations. The facilities are a bit old, and the soundproofing is not great, but at this price point, it is still extremely value for money.

name: St Giles Makati – A St Giles Hotel, Manila
detail: When I come to Makati, I usually stay here, and I think the overall cost performance is really good. It's located on a main road, so you can hear quite a bit of car horns, but it has a pool, breakfast included, and there are various shops and malls nearby, which I think makes it very convenient.

name: Seda Bonifacio Global City Manila
detail: It had the atmosphere of a mid-range business hotel located in the safest district of Manila. The building and rooms weren't very new, but they were sufficiently clean. The water pressure and temperature in the shower were comfortable. If there was a drawback, it was that the towels felt old (they were clean and laundered, but their age was undeniable). The hustle and bustle of the city was uniquely Manila, yet the streets were beautifully maintained, and the shopping areas were abundant. Although this stay was for business, I think it would also be a lovely hotel to relax in for sightseeing. I found the hotel staff's genuine smiles and hospitality remarkable. The breakfast was satisfying, featuring local dishes like sweetened rice with adzuki beans, adding a touch of regional flavor that was enjoyable.
area: Bonifacio Global City (BGC) / Taguig,Manila - View on map

name: The Mini Suites at Eton Tower Makati
detail: The cost performance was incredibly good. The location in Makati, where the hotel is situated, is quite neat and lined with buildings, making it excellent. However, since the train station is far, I recommend using Grab. There is no hairdryer in the room, but if you ask at the front desk, they will deliver one to your room. Here are the points to be careful about, and the good points below: • There is a TV with a variety of channels. • Being a tower, the view from the window is beautiful. • The shower room is very clean and equipped with soap and other amenities. • There are three large mirrors. • The toilet and shower room are nicely separated. • The front desk staff are polite, elegant, and very kind. • The pool is spacious and very satisfying, and they also lend towels. • The gym is clean. • There is a 7-Eleven just a minute's walk away. • The cleaning is thorough. That's all. This was the first time I stayed in such a wonderful hotel at this price. Thank you very much for taking care of me.

name: Oyster Plaza Hotel
detail: Due to the impact of the typhoon, transportation was disrupted, so I made an emergency reservation. It is close to the airport and also near several bus terminals heading to northern Luzon, making it very convenient for transportation. I stayed there a few days ago, and the staff remembered my face, which made my stay comfortable. The food menu at the restaurant, or rather coffee shop, is reasonably priced and includes breakfast. It's almost possible to walk to Chowking, a popular Chinese fast-food chain in the Philippines, without getting wet. There’s no trouble finding meals. The room is used but properly cleaned. It's not spacious, but it's more than sufficient. The price is appropriate. However, the downside is the severe noise from planes, trains, and cars, much like near Osaka's Shin-Osaka Station.

name: Savoy Hotel Manila near Airport NAIA Terminal 3 MNL
detail: I used this when I arrived in Manila for the first time on a late-night flight. It's about a 15-minute walk from the airport. However, there are no traffic signals or crosswalks, so you need to be careful of cars when crossing the major road. It may be a bit of a detour, but I think it's safer to use the airport-connected passage RUNWAY MANILA to cross the main road. I checked in around 3 AM, and the staff were kind and handled everything smoothly. The room had everything I needed. It was clean and comfortable to sleep in. I booked a room with an airport view, but since there are quite a few flights and there's a bypass right in front of me, there was quite a bit of traffic, and I found the noise a bit bothersome. If you want a quiet rest, it might be better to stay in a room without an airport view. The breakfast was served buffet-style and was very satisfying. I definitely recommend adding it when making a reservation. Once you leave the hotel, you can easily catch a jeepney on the main road. It's conveniently located for heading towards Baclaran (you can get off partway and walk to the church or market), making it a good place to start experiencing the Philippines. I would like to use it again when I go to Manila.
